text:
FIFA World Cup a ɛto so anum no, wɔbɔɔ no Switzerland fi 16 June kɔsi 4 July 1954, wɔ akuro a ɛyɛ six mu wɔ ɛberɛ a ɛdi akyi a na ɛwɔ amateurism ne professional game mfitiaseɛ ntam. Teams 16 no, wɔde too groups anan mu wɔ format a ɛyɛ nwonwa: group biara mu no, seeded sides mmienu no bɔɔ unseeded mmienu no nko, seeds nhyiaa wɔn ho, na group match a ɛtie no kɔ extra time. Group biara mu top two no kɔɔ knockout phase a ɛyɛ quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match ne final.

Tournament no bɛyɛɛ nea ɛwɔ goal dodow sen biara wɔ World Cup abakɔsɛm mu sɛnea ɛda hɔ, goals 140 wɔ matches 26 mu, bɛyɛ 5.38 wɔ game biara mu. Ne match a ɛyɛ nwonwa paa ne Austria-Switzerland quarter-final no, Austria dii nkunim 7-5, na goals 12 a wɔbom yɛ record ma match baako wɔ World Cup mu. Hungary 'Golden Team' a wɔfrɛ no Mighty Magyars no, bae wɔ unbeaten run a ɛwareeɛ so na wɔde wɔn ho too mu sɛ wɔbɛdi nkunim bere a wɔbobɔɔ West Germany 8-3 wɔ group stage no mu. Hungary Sandor Kocsis dii nkunim sɛ tournament no top scorer wɔ goals 11.

Wɔhyiaa bio wɔ final no mu wɔ Wankdorf Stadium wɔ Bern, wɔ nnipa bɛyɛ 60,000 anim. Ferenc Puskas a ɔresan afi injury mu no, ɔbuee scoring no wɔ sima 6, na Zoltan Czibor yɛɛ 2-0 wɔ sima 8 mu. Nanso West Germany san bɔɔ Max Morlock wɔ sima 10 ne Helmut Rahn wɔ sima 18. Bere a game no da hɔ no, Rahn wiee wɔ sima 84 mu yɛɛ 3-2; Puskas 'equaliser' a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ akyiri no, wɔde offside too mu wɔ asɛm a wɔnnye nni mu. Nea ɛbaa no, ɛyɛ upset wɔ Hungarians a wɔn ani agye wɔn ho paa no so, na wɔfrɛɛ no 'Miracle of Bern' na ɛde West Germany ne title a ɛdi kan wɔ wiase. Austria dii nkunim wɔ mmiensa na Uruguay dii nkunim wɔ mmaanu. 1954 finals no nso na ɛyɛ World Cup a wɔsan too gu so wɔ TV so. Award a ɛyɛ best-player no nni hɔ ma tournament no.
